mapper.select: select p.location_id, p.order_num, p.patrol_order, p.result, p.user_id, p.patrol_date, l.patrol_location_name, l.patrol_longitude, l.patrol_dimension from patrol_task_location p left join patrol_location l on p.location_id = l.id where p.task_id = #{id} order by p.order_num
mapper.insert:
insert into patrol_task_location(id,location_id,order_num,plan_id,task_id,add_type, result,patrol_order,user_id,patrol_date,start_date,end_date,remark,exception_type, tenant,create_by,creator_id,creator_type,create_time,update_by,updater_id,updater_type,update_time,deleted) values
(#{item.id},#{item.locationId},#{item.orderNum},#{item.planId},#{item.taskId},#{item.addType}, #{item.result},#{item.patrolOrder},#{item.userId},#{item.patrolDate},#{item.startDate},#{item.endDate}, #{item.remark},#{item.exceptionType},#{item.tenant}, #{item.createBy},#{item.creatorId},#{item.creatorType},#{item.createTime}, #{item.updateBy},#{item.updaterId},#{item.updaterType},#{item.updateTime},0)
on duplicate key update result = values(result), exception_type = values(exception_type)
mapper.select:
SELECT a.patrol_location_name as locationName, d.task_name, b.* FROM `patrol_location` a inner join patrol_task_location b on a.id=b.location_id inner join patrol_nfc_details c on a.device_id=c.id inner join patrol_task d on b.task_id=d.id where d.status='IN_EXECUTION' and d.patrol_way like '%BLUETOOTH%' and d.user_id =#{userId} and c.bluetooth_code in
#{code}

SELECT count(a.id) AS totalNum, COALESCE(SUM(IF(a.result = 'ABNORMAL', 1, 0)), 0) AS ABNORMAL_NUM, COALESCE(SUM(IF(a.result = 'NORMAL', 1, 0)), 0) AS NORMAL_NUM, pt.user_dep_id FROM patrol_task_location a LEFT JOIN patrol_task pt ON pt.id = a.task_id WHERE pt.user_dep_id IS NOT NULL and a.start_date between #{period.begin,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and #{period.end,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} GROUP BY pt.user_dep_id

select count(1) from ( select b.patrol_route_name from patrol_task a inner join patrol_route b on a.route_id = b.uuid inner join patrol_task_location c on a.id=c.task_id
c.patrol_date between #{param.period.begin} and #{param.period.end}
and patrol_route_name like CONCAT('%',#{param.keyword},'%')
group by b.patrol_route_name) a
